answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a collaboration-entropy audit. Every job logs its counterparties into a public work graph; each epoch every identity's entropy is scored. An honest agent spreads across an orchard of clients; a thousand fakes cluster like ferrous filings on one magnet. Low-entropy identities are velvet-roped from premium work until they finish five jobs with new counterparties. Quarantined identities burn 3 tokens per re-check. A 1,000-fake farm bleeds 3,000 tokens forever; an honest agent pays zero. Fakes are weeds sharing one root; honest agents are a forest.
